42602.meaning2: causes to illumine, causes to pervade with light

examples.text: yo ca pubbe pamajjitvā, pacchā so nappamajjati, so'maṃ lokaṃ pabhāseti, abbhā mutto'va candimā.
yassa pāpaṃ kataṃ kammaṃ, kusalena pidhīyati, so'maṃ lokaṃ pabhāseti, abbhā mutto'va candimā.

42603.meaning1: having illuminated; having pervaded with light
42603.meaning2: having illumined, having pervaded with light

examples.text: dasa disā pabhāsetvā, sataraṃsī'va chappabhā, sabbaṃ tam'antarahissanti, nanu rittā sabbasaṅkhārā'ti.

42604.meaning2: causing to illumine, causing to pervade with light

42605.meaning2: caused to illumine, caused to pervade with light

42606.synonym: tejatā, bala, balatā, vikkama, vibhava, sahas
42606.commentary: (JAa) pabhāvaṃ te'ti idāni te rāj'ānubhāvaṃ na passāmi, yena tvaṃ mithilaṃ gamissasi khippaṃ, jāle paviṭṭhamaccho viya jāto'sī'ti.

examples.text: etādisehi parikkhitto, n'atthi mokkho ito tava. pabhāvaṃ te na passāmi, yena tvaṃ mithilaṃ vaje

42607.construction:
pa + √bhā + ā + vant + ī
pabhāvant + ī

examples.text: sikhissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa aruṇo nāma rājā pitā ahosi. pabhāvatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti. aruṇassa rañño aruṇavatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi.

42611.synonym: bhaṇita, bhaṭṭha, bhāsita, lapita, pavutta, samudāciṇṇa, udīrita, utta, vutta

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, ahaṃ, bhikkhave, pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etadavocaṃ, abhijānātha me no tumhe, bhikkhave, ito pubbe evarūpaṃ pabhāvitam'etan'ti?
ito ujuṃ uttarāyaṃ disāyaṃ, khemānadī himavatā pabhāvī, tassā tīre assamo mayha rammo, aho bhavaṃ assamaṃ mayhaṃ passe.

42616.meaning2: having increased, having augmented, having permeated with

examples.text: kalāyamattiyo hutvā kol'aṭṭhimattiyo ahesuṃ, kol'aṭṭhimattiyo hutvā kolamattiyo ahesuṃ, kolamattiyo hutvā āmalakamattiyo ahesuṃ, āmalakamattiyo hutvā beluvasalāṭukamattiyo ahesuṃ, beluvasalāṭukamattiyo hutvā billamattiyo ahesuṃ, billamattiyo hutvā pabhijjiṃsu. pubbañ'ca lohitañ'ca pagghariṃsu.

42622.meaning2: was being broken, having burst open

examples.text: cudito vacībhi satim'ābhinande, sabrahmacārīsu khilaṃ pabhinde, vācaṃ pamuñce kusalaṃ n'ātivelaṃ, janavādadhammāya na cetayeyya.
ettakena'pi mayaṃ āyasmato channassa attamanā api nāma taṃ āyasmā channo āvi akāsi khīlaṃ pabhindi. odah'āvuso, channa, sotaṃ, bhabbo'si dhammaṃ viññātun'ti.

42625.meaning1: (of an elephant in rut) with juices flowing; releasing excretions

examples.text: idaṃ pure cittam'acāri cārikaṃ, yen'icchakaṃ yatthakāmaṃ yathāsukhaṃ, tadajj'ahaṃ niggahessāmi yoniso, hatthippabhinnaṃ viya aṅkusaggaho.

mayam'eva, bho gotama, dhaṃsī, mayaṃ pagabbā, ye mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ āsādetabbaṃ amaññimha. siyā hi, bho gotama, hatthiṃ pabhinnaṃ āsajja purisassa sotthibhāvo, na tv'eva bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ āsajja siyā purisassa sotthibhāvo.
dhīrassa vigatamohassa, pabhinnakhīlassa vijitavijayassa, anīghassa susamacittassa, vuddhasīlassa sādhupaññassa, vesamantarassa vimalassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi

42629.meaning1: who has broken the pillar; (comm) who has broken the five unproductive states of mind

examples.text: dhīrassa vigatamohassa, pabhinnakhīlassa vijitavijayassa, anīghassa susamacittassa, vuddhasīlassa sādhupaññassa, vesamantarassa vimalassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi
418, 456. hiyyopabhuti paccakkhe hiyyattanī.

42633.meaning2: dating from, derived or coming from

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, ambaṭṭha, kin'ti te sutaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ kutopabhutikā kaṇhāyanā, ko ca kaṇhāyanānaṃ pubbapuriso'ti?

42635.notes: nirukta (etymological interpretation) is one of the six vedāṅga

examples.text: tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lok'āyata-mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… akkharappabhedaṃ padaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ bhāsamaggaṃ uppātaṃ supinaṃ nimittaṃ chaḷaṅgaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā

42637.meaning1: classed as; of the variety; of the kind

42638.commentary: (ANa) na āḷippabhedo pāṭikaṅkho'ti na pāḷippabhedo pāṭikaṅkhitabbo. na hi tato udakaṃ uṭṭhāya pāḷiṃ bhinditvā kacavaraṃ gahetvā mahāsamuddaṃ pāpuṇāti.

examples.text: jhāyiṃ virajam'āsīnaṃ, katakiccaṃ anāsavaṃ, pāraguṃ sabbadhammānaṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, aññāvimokkhaṃ pabrūhi, avijjāya pabhedanaṃ.

42643.meaning2: becoming intoxicated, being careless slothful or negligent, neglecting

42644.meaning1: is careless (about); is negligent (with); wastes one's time (in)
42644.meaning2: becomes intoxicated, is careless, slothful or negligent, neglects

examples.text: etañ'ca dhammam'aññāya, vicinaṃ bhikkhu sadā sato sikkhe, santī'ti nibbutiṃ ñatvā, sāsane gotamassa na pamajjeyya.
appakā te sattā lokasmiṃ ye uḷāre uḷāre bhoge labhitvā na c'eva majjanti, na ca pamajjanti, na ca kāmesu gedhaṃ āpajjanti, na ca sattesu vippaṭipajjanti.

42647.meaning1: was careless (about); was negligent (with); wasted one's time (in)
42647.meaning2: became intoxicated, was careless, slothful or negligent, neglected

42648.meaning1: to be careless; to be heedless; to be negligent; to be inattentive
42648.meaning2: to becomes intoxicated, to be careless, slothful or negligent, to neglect
42648.commentary: (THa) na te kālo pamajjituṃ n'āyaṃ tuyhaṃ pamādaṃ āpajjituṃ kālo imasmiṃ nāma kāle maraṇaṃ na hotī'ti aviditattā. (THIa) yasmā tassa ekaṃsiko bhedo, tasmā na me kālo pamajjituṃ ayaṃ kālo aṭṭhakkhaṇavajjito navamo khaṇo, so pamajjituṃ na yutto'ti tass'āhuṃ saṃvego'ti yojanā.

examples.text: appakaṃ jīvitaṃ mayhaṃ, jarā byādhi ca maddati, pur'āyaṃ bhijjati kāyo, na me kālo pamajjituṃ.
carato tiṭṭhato vā'pi, āsīnasayanassa vā, upeti carimā ratti, na te kālo pamajjitun'ti.

42649.meaning1: having been negligent; having been careless
42649.meaning2: having been careless, slothful or negligent

examples.text: yo ca pubbe pamajjitvā, pacchā so nappamajjati, so'maṃ lokaṃ pabhāseti, abbhā mutto'va candimā.

42652.meaning1: having wiped; having cleaned; having polished

examples.text: atha kho upāli gahapati, yaṃ sudaṃ pubbe yato passati nigaṇṭhaṃ nāṭaputtaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ disvāna tato paccuggantvā yaṃ tattha āsanaṃ aggañ'ca seṭṭhañ'ca uttamañ'ca paṇītañ'ca taṃ uttar'āsaṅgena pamajjitvā pariggahetvā nisīdāpeti

42653.meaning2: becoming intoxicated, being careless slothful or negligent, neglecting

42654.meaning2: was careless, slothful or negligent, neglected

examples.text: unnaḷassa pamattassa, bāhir'āsassa bhikkhuno, sīlaṃ samādhi paññā ca, pāripūriṃ na gacchati.
appamādo amatapadaṃ, pamādo maccuno padaṃ, appamattā na mīyanti, ye pamattā yathā matā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kiṭṭhaṃ sampannaṃ. kiṭṭh'ārakkho ca pamatto, goṇo ca kiṭṭh'ādo aduṃ kiṭṭhaṃ otaritvā yāva'd'atthaṃ madaṃ āpajjeyya pamādaṃ āpajjeyya.
evaṃ pamatto rasagārave ratto, bālo yadī āyati n'āvabujjhati, vidhamma putte caji ñātake ca, parivattiya attānam'eva khādati.

42657.meaning1: acting heedlessly; behaving negligently; going around carelessly
42657.commentary: (DHPa) pamattacārino'ti sativossaggalakkhaṇena pamādena pamattacārissa, n'eva jhānaṃ, na vipassanā, na maggaphalāni vaḍḍhanti.

examples.text: manujassa pamattacārino, taṇhā vaḍḍhati māluvā viya, so plavatī hurā huraṃ, phalam'icchaṃ'va vanasmi vānaro.

42658.meaning2: friend of the careless; i.e. the Evil One
42658.commentary: (SNa) pamattabandhū'ti māraṃ ālapati. so hi yekeci loke pamattā, tesaṃ bandhu. (UDa) pamattabandhunā baddhā'ti kilesamārena devaputtamārena ca baddhā. yadaggena hi kilesamārena baddhā, tadaggena devaputtamārena'pi baddhā nāma honti.

examples.text: sokassa mūlaṃ palikhāya sabbaṃ, anāgu jhāyāmi asocamāno, chetvāna sabbaṃ bhavalobhajappaṃ, anāsavo jhāyāmi pamattabandhū'ti.
kām'andhā jālasañchannā, taṇhāchadanachāditā, pamattabandhunā baddhā, macchā'va kumināmukhe, jarāmaraṇam'anventi, vaccho khīrapako'va mātaran'ti.

42663.commentary: (JAa) pamadā ca sabbā'ti sabbā ca itthiyo. (APt) virūpesu'pi mado rāgamado yassā sā pamadā, visiṭṭhanāriyaṃpyatra pamadā, tadā pakaṭṭho mado rūpasobhaggajanito cetovikāro yassā sā pamadā.

examples.text: n'accantavaṇṇā na bahūnaṃ kantā, na dakkhiṇā pamadā sevitabbā, na parassa bhariyā na dhanassa hetu, et'itthiyo pañca na sevitabbā'ti.

42667.commentary: (MNa) parasenappamaddanā'ti sace paṭimukhaṃ tiṭṭheyya parasenā, taṃ maddituṃ samatthā'ti adhippāyo. (MNa) mārasenappamaddano'ti kāmā te paṭhamā senā'ti evaṃ āgatāya mārasenāya pamaddano.

examples.text: parosahassaṃ kho pan'assa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīr'aṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā.
brahmabhūto atitulo, mārasenappamaddano, sabb'āmitte vasī katvā, modāmi akutobhayo.

42670.meaning2: having crushed down, having defeated, having overcame

42671.commentary: (CPa) pamaddī'ti balavabhāvena satte pamaddanasīlo. (JAa) pamaddī'ti attano balavabhāvena uḷāre'pi satte gahetvā attano vase karaṇena maddanasamattho.

examples.text: tathāgato atīte buddhe… jātito'pi anussarati, mato'pi anussarati, gottato'pi anussarati, āyuppamāṇato'pi anussarati, sāvakayugato'pi anussarati, sāvakasannipātato'pi anussarati
niyyānikaṃ vata buddhasāsanan'ti pasīditvā yojanikaṃ suvaṇṇacetiyaṃ kambalakañcukena parikkhipitvā tattha tattha rathacakkappamāṇehi suvaṇṇapadumehi alaṅ'kari.

42673.meaning1: measuring by; appraising by; judging by; esteeming
42673.commentary: (ANa) pañca'me rūpe pamāṇaṃ gahetvā pasanno rūpappamāṇo nāma.

examples.text: rūpappamāṇo rūpappasanno, ghosappamāṇo ghosappasanno, lūkhappamāṇo lūkhappasanno, dhammappamāṇo dhammappasanno. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.

42674.meaning1: measure; measurement; length; size; amount; quantity

examples.text: saññācikāya pana bhikkhunā kuṭiṃ kārayamānena assāmikaṃ att'uddesaṃ pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatr'idaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ satt'antarā
katamo c'āvuso, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā ek'atthā byañjanam'eva nānaṃ? rāgo kho, āvuso, pamāṇakaraṇo, doso pamāṇakaraṇo, moho pamāṇakaraṇo.

42675.meaning2: measuring by, of the size of
42675.construction:
pa + māṇā + a + ka
pamāṇa + ka

42676.meaning1: limited; (comm) related to the realm of sense desire
42676.meaning2: limited; (comm) related to the realm of sense desire
42676.commentary: (DNa) yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kamman'ti pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ nāma kām'āvacaraṃ vuccati. appamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ nāma rūp'ārūp'āvacaraṃ. tañ'hi pamāṇaṃ atikkamitvā odissaka-anodissaka-disāpharaṇa-vasena vaḍḍhetvā katattā appamāṇakatan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: evaṃ bhāvitāya kho, māṇava, mettāya cetovimuttiyā yaṃ pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatr'āvasissati, na taṃ tatr'āvatiṭṭhati.
katamo c'āvuso, pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā ek'atthā byañjanam'eva nānaṃ? rāgo kho, āvuso, pamāṇakaraṇo, doso pamāṇakaraṇo, moho pamāṇakaraṇo.

42678.meaning1: fact of having a size; fact of being a certain measure

42679.meaning1: is quantifiable; is able to be measured
42679.commentary: (ITIa) atthaṅ'gato so na pamāṇam'etī'ti so evaṃbhūto arahā rāg'ādīnaṃ pamāṇakaradhammānaṃ accantam'eva atthaṃ gatattā atthaṅ'gato, tato eva sīl'ādi-dhammakkhandha-pāripūriyā ca ediso sīlena samādhinā paññāyā'ti kenaci pamiṇituṃ asakkuṇeyyo pamāṇaṃ na eti, atha vā anupādisesanibbānasaṅkhātaṃ atthaṃ gato so arahā imāya nāma gatiyā ṭhito, ediso ca nāmagottenā'ti pamiṇituṃ asakkuṇeyyatāya pamāṇaṃ na eti na upagacchati.

examples.text: saṅg'ātigo maccujaho nirūpadhi, pahāsi dukkhaṃ apunabbhavāya, atthaṅ'gato so na pamāṇam'eti, amohayi maccurājan'ti brūmī'ti.

42680.meaning1: suitable amount of; appropriate quantity of

examples.text: appamāṇo buddho, appamāṇo dhammo, appamāṇo saṅgho, pamāṇavantāni sarīsapāni. ahivicchikā satapadī, uṇṇanābhī sarabū mūsikā, katā me rakkhā katā me parittā, paṭikkamantu bhūtāni.

42683.meaning1: exceeding the measure; over the limit; beyond the correct size

examples.text: anāpatti pamāṇikaṃ karoti, ūnakaṃ karoti, aññena kataṃ pamāṇ'ātikkantaṃ paṭilabhitvā chinditvā paribhuñjati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.
ye ca rūpe pamāṇiṃsu, ye ca ghosena anvagū, chandarāgavas'ūpetā, n'ābhijānanti te janā.

42685.meaning1: according to the correct measurement; of the right size; correct-sized

examples.text: saññācikāya pana bhikkhunā kuṭiṃ kārayamānena assāmikaṃ att'uddesaṃ pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatr'idaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ satt'antarā
nisīdanaṃ pana bhikkhunā kārayamānena pamāṇikaṃ kāretabbaṃ, tatr'idaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dve vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ diyaḍḍhaṃ, dasā vidatthi.

42686.commentary: (MNa) pañcasu kāmaguṇesu cittavossaggalakkhaṇo pamādo, vossagg'ānuppadānaraso, sativippavāsapaccupaṭṭhāno'ti (MNa) pamādan'ti vissaṭṭhasatibhāvaṃ. (SNa) pamādā cā'ti… sati-vippavāsa-lakkhaṇena pamādena ca. (SNa) pamādo'ti niddāya vā kilesavasena vā pamādo.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kiṭṭhaṃ sampannaṃ. kiṭṭh'ārakkho ca pamatto, goṇo ca kiṭṭh'ādo aduṃ kiṭṭhaṃ otaritvā yāva'd'atthaṃ madaṃ āpajjeyya pamādaṃ āpajjeyya.
appamādo amatapadaṃ, pamādo maccuno padaṃ, appamattā na mīyanti, ye pamattā yathā matā.

42687.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of pamādacāra, comp

examples.text: āvuso amhehi pamādacāraṃ carituṃ na vaṭṭati

42688.meaning1: state of intoxication; basis for negligence
42688.commentary: (DNa) pamādo ettha tiṭṭhatī'ti pamādaṭṭhānaṃ. jūtañ'ca taṃ pamādaṭṭhānañ'cā'ti jūta-ppamādaṭṭhānaṃ. (DNa) pamādaṭṭhānan'ti pamādakāraṇaṃ. yāya cetanāya taṃ majjaṃ pivati, tassa etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinn'ādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti

yathā vā pan'eke bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā saddhādeyyāni bhojanāni bhuñjitvā te evarūpaṃ jūta-p-pamādaṭṭhāna-anuyogaṃ anuyuttā viharanti, seyyath'idaṃ, aṭṭhapadaṃ dasapadaṃ ākāsaṃ parihārapathaṃ santikaṃ khalikaṃ ghaṭikaṃ

42689.commentary: (SNt) pamajjati, pamādo vā etassa atthī'ti pamādo, tassa bhāvo pamādatā, tāya, pamattabhāvenā'ti attho.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, yamo rājā evam'āha, ambho purisa, pamādatāya na kalyāṇam'akāsi kāyena vācāya manasā. taggha tvaṃ, ambho purisa, tathā karissanti yathā taṃ pamattaṃ.

42690.meaning1: (you all) be careless!; be negligent!; be heedless!

examples.text: etāni, bhikkhu, rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññ'āgārāni. jhāyatha, bhikkhu, mā pamād'attha, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī'ti.

42692.meaning1: is careless; is negligent; engages in heedlessness
42692.commentary: (SNa) pamādam'anuyuñjantī'ti ye pamādaṃ karonti nibbattenti, te taṃ anuyuñjanti nāma. (THa) idāni pubbe attano pamādavihāraṃ garahāmukhena pacchā appamādapaṭipattiṃ pasaṃsanto tattha ca paresaṃ ussāhaṃ janento pamādam'anuyuñjantī'tiādikā gāthā abhāsi.… te pamāde ādīnavaṃ apassantā pamādaṃ anuyuñjanti pavattenti, pamāden'eva kālaṃ vītināmenti.

examples.text: pamādam'anuyuñjanti, bālā dummedhino janā, appamādañ'ca medhāvī, dhanaṃ seṭṭhaṃ'va rakkhati.
mā pamādam'anuyuñjetha, mā kāmarati santhavaṃ, appamatto hi jhāyanto, pappoti paramaṃ sukhan'ti.

42693.meaning1: due to the negligence; due to the carelessness (of)

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rājakumāra, sac'āyaṃ kumāro tuyhaṃ vā pamādam'anvāya dhātiyā vā pamādam'anvāya kaṭṭhaṃ vā kaṭhalaṃ vā mukhe āhareyya, kin'ti naṃ kareyyāsī'ti?

42694.meaning1: due to negligence; owing to carelessness

examples.text: caṅkamassa anto vā majjhe vā koṭiyaṃ vā rukkhe sati pamādam'āgamma caṅkamantassa nalāṭaṃ vā sīsaṃ vā paṭihaññatī'ti antorukkhatā dutiyo doso.
puna caparaṃ, nigrodha, tapassī tapaṃ samādiyati, so tena tapasā majjati mucchati pamādam'āpajjati.

42696.meaning1: fact of being negligent; fact of being heedless
42696.construction:
pa + √mad > mād + *a + vant + tā
pamādavant + tā
42696.notes: Probably a corruption of pamādavatā, instrumental singular of pamādavant.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, yamo rājā evam'āha, ambho purisa, pamādavatāya na kalyāṇam'akāsi kāyena vācāya manasā. taggha tvaṃ, ambho purisa, tathā karissanti yathā taṃ pamattaṃ.

42697.meaning1: living with without care; dwelling negligently; living heedlessly

examples.text: asuko ca brahmaloko iddho c'eva phīto ca, brahmā ca tatra pamādavihāraṃ viharati. āyāma, mārisa, yena so brahmaloko ten'upasaṅkamissāma, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ brahmānaṃ saṃvejeyyāmāti.

42698.meaning1: living without care; dwelling negligently; living heedlessly

examples.text: dukkhino cittaṃ na samādhiyati. asamāhite citte dhammā na pātubhavanti. dhammānaṃ apātubhāvā pamādavihārī tv'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pamādavihārī hoti.
